# ESE J Engineering Ltd

> ESE J Engineering Ltd is a Nigerian engineering and construction company founded in 2009 by CEO Ese Joy. It delivers project management, mechanical works, certified welding & fabrication, plumbing, procurement and full-scale building construction for residential, commercial and industrial clients across Nigeria. Registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission (RC 7101423) and a corporate member of the Nigerian Association of Technologists in Engineering (NATE).

- Website: https://www.esejengineering.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +234 806 430 4119
- Email: esejengineering@gmail.com
- Address: 165, Murtala Muhammed Way, Nigeria
- Founded: 2009 · 30+ projects completed · 10+ skilled professionals
- Clients include: Zakhem Construction Nigeria Ltd, NIPCO Plc, Enikom Engineering Ltd, Greenway Nigeria Ltd, EDSOGPADEC, Earth Geo Construction, Citi Broads Engineering

## Services

- [Project Management](https://www.esejengineering.com/services/project-management): planning, scheduling, cost estimation, site supervision, QA/HSE management, handover.
- [Mechanical Works](https://www.esejengineering.com/services/mechanical-works): installation, maintenance and repair of mechanical systems; process piping; HDPE pipe butt-fusion; pumps; testing & commissioning.
- [Certified Welding & Fabrication](https://www.esejengineering.com/services/welding-fabrication): structural and pipe welding, tanks and vessels, architectural metalwork, weld inspection and QA/QC.
- [Plumbing Solutions](https://www.esejengineering.com/services/plumbing): commercial and industrial plumbing, water supply, drainage, pressure testing, maintenance.
- [Procurement](https://www.esejengineering.com/services/procurement): sourcing and supply of engineering materials and equipment, vendor qualification, logistics.
- [Building Construction](https://www.esejengineering.com/services/building-construction): design coordination, earthworks, foundations, civil works, residential, commercial and industrial buildings.

## Credentials

- CAC Certificate of Incorporation, RC 7101423 (2023)
- NATE Corporate Member (2024)
- HND, Welding & Fabrication Engineering Technology, Petroleum Training Institute (2018)
- QA/QC in Welding, Petroleum Training Institute (2015)
- HSE Level 3, Institute of Safety Professionals of Nigeria (2015)
- ITF NISDP Welding & Fabrication (2018); OSHAcademy PPE (2014); Occupational Safety Academy HSE (2011)
